symptom: After a resumed worker said hello, the relay took 1.0-6.2 s more to dial it, which delayed the waiting app's ENGINE_READY. A ready hint woke the relay's retry loop, but a failed first attempt after the hint waited the grown backoff (up to 2 s) before trying again.
rule: zstack-review locks and time windows: an event that signals readiness must reset retry backoff, not only interrupt the current wait. Record attempt counts on readiness timings so post-hint failures are visible.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/cloud/relay.test.ts -t "restarts the retry backoff"
